editorial:
Imagine a killer so mean that even death cannot stop him. You get to meet Max Jenke, a guy known as Meat Cleaver, who spends his time killing people in the most brutal ways possible. After a detective finally catches him and puts him away, Max dies in prison, but he comes back as a ghost with a serious grudge. The vibe is very much like an old-school slasher movie where the bad guy just won't stay down. It feels like a dark carnival ride where you know things are going to get messy, but you can't look away because the setup is so wild.

What really pops here are the practical effects and the over-the-top gore that fans of the 80s will love. The pacing is mostly steady, though some parts drag a bit. If you enjoy seeing a relentless monster chase people, you will have a blast. It is a great pick for a late-night movie marathon with friends. You should try to find the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or check if it is available for rent on Apple TV for a quick watch.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the ghost of Max Jenke tries to finish his revenge. You see a final showdown where the survivors fight back against the supernatural killer. It turns out that being a ghost doesn't make him invincible. After a messy battle, Max is finally stopped for good, giving the remaining characters a chance to escape. The movie wraps up with the idea that some evil is too strong for this world to hold, but it can still be beaten.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s slasher films and practical gore effects.
